instagram.caption:
The finished schoolwork.
The Study Desk in the Kids Bedroom. One clear surface where homework actually gets started rather than avoided.

What done looks like:
1. Desk surface bare except a lamp
2. A pen cup
3. One tray holding live work. Laptop charger threaded through a clip on the desk edge so the plug never drops behind the desk. Books on the shelf above
4. None stacked on the surface. Chair empty

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success study desk.
